title_original: Peter Facinelli Among Cast Set For Indie Drama ‘1 AM Pacific Time’

blocks.text: EXCLUSIVE: Production has wrapped in Los Angeles on the indie drama 1 Am Pacific Time , with Peter Facinelli ( Twilight ) among the leading cast.

The film also stars Alex Vaughan ( Monster: The Lyle and Erik Menendez Story ), Billiards U.S. Open Champion Jeanette Lee, and Erica Muñoz ( Grey’s Anatomy ). Filmmaker Brandon DeLany ( Broadway Sandwich ) has written and directed the film.

The film follows a struggling pool hustler, played by Vaughan, who sees a shot at redemption when he wins a large sum of money from the wrong person. He is thrust into a world of dangerous criminals, impossible odds, and life-altering choices, ultimately forced to decide what his own life is worth.
Facinelli plays the Boss, a ruthless figure whose cash ends up in the pool hustler’s hands, and intends to get it back, one way or another.

Muñoz and DeLany, who previously served as producers on the six-time Emmy-nominated PBS series Broadway Sandwich , are producing under their production company, Alexandria Films. Other producers include Meg Saricks, Aaron Champion, and Facinelli.

Facinelli recently starred in and produced The Unbreakable Boy , and co-directed, produced, and starred in On Fire . Muñoz is a Broadway performer known for her breakout role as Mimi in Rent , as well as her leading role in HBO’s Long Gone By . DeLany is known for producing the OWN series Deep Shift .
